sets.title: Booking a private dining room
sets.transcript:
M: Hello, I'm calling from Kessler Engineering. We're planning a retirement party for one of our directors, and I'd like to reserve your private dining room for Friday the twentieth.
W: Certainly. How many guests are you expecting?
M: Around thirty-five.
W: That's fine — the room seats up to forty. To hold the reservation, we'll need a deposit of two hundred dollars. Could you also send me your menu choices by e-mail before Wednesday? That way the kitchen can order ingredients in time.
M: Sure, I'll do that today.

questions.prompt: Why is the man calling?

choices.B: To reserve a room for an event

questions.explanation_vi: 'I'd like to reserve your private dining room' cho tiệc nghỉ hưu.

questions.prompt: How many guests does the man expect?
questions.explanation_vi: 'Around thirty-five.' Con số 40 là sức chứa tối đa của phòng.

questions.prompt: What does the woman ask the man to do?

choices.C: Pay the full price in advance

questions.explanation_vi: 'Could you also send me your menu choices by e-mail before Wednesday?'

sets.title: Broken copier
sets.transcript:
W: Excuse me, Paul. Do you know what's wrong with the copier? It keeps showing an error message.
M: The paper tray is jammed again. I already called the technician, but he can't come until tomorrow morning.
W: Oh no. The handouts are for the two o'clock meeting.
M: In that case, why don't you use the copier on the third floor? The marketing team won't mind.
W: Good idea. I'll head up there now.

questions.prompt: What problem are the speakers discussing?
questions.explanation_vi: Máy photo bị kẹt giấy, báo lỗi.

questions.prompt: What does the woman imply when she says, "The handouts are for the two o'clock meeting"?

choices.A: She has already finished the copies.
choices.C: She does not need the handouts.

questions.explanation_vi: Thợ sửa mai mới đến, nhưng tài liệu cần cho cuộc họp lúc 2 giờ hôm nay → cô ấy không thể chờ.

questions.prompt: What does the man suggest?
questions.explanation_vi: 'why don't you use the copier on the third floor?'

sets.title: Choosing a candidate (three speakers)
sets.transcript:
W1: So, we've interviewed all five applicants for the graphic designer position. Who stood out to you?
M: I liked Akira Sato. Her portfolio was excellent, especially the packaging designs.
W2: I agree, but she's only worked with print materials. Most of our projects now are for Web sites and mobile apps.
M: That's true. Still, she said she's taking an online course in Web design.
W1: Let's invite her back for a second interview and give her a short digital design task. I'll call her this afternoon to arrange a time.

questions.prompt: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
questions.explanation_vi: Họ bàn về các ứng viên cho vị trí thiết kế đồ họa.

questions.prompt: What concern is mentioned about Ms. Sato?
questions.explanation_vi: 'she's only worked with print materials' trong khi dự án chủ yếu là web/app.

questions.prompt: What will the first woman do this afternoon?
questions.explanation_vi: 'I'll call her this afternoon to arrange a time.'

sets.title: Returning headphones
sets.transcript:
M: Hi, I bought these wireless headphones here last week, but the left side stopped working.
W: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have your receipt?
M: Unfortunately, no. I think I threw it away.
W: That's OK. If you paid by card, I can look up the purchase. Could I see the card you used?
M: Here you go.
W: Thanks. Yes, here it is. Since the model is sold out, I can give you store credit for the full amount, or you can wait about a week for a replacement.

questions.prompt: Why does the man want to return the headphones?

choices.A: He received them as a gift.

questions.explanation_vi: 'the left side stopped working' → hàng lỗi (defective).

questions.prompt: What does the woman ask to see?
questions.explanation_vi: Khách không có hóa đơn nên cô ấy xin xem thẻ đã dùng để thanh toán.

questions.prompt: What does the woman say about the model?

choices.B: It is on sale this week.
choices.C: It is currently out of stock.
choices.D: It comes with a free case.

questions.explanation_vi: 'the model is sold out' = hết hàng (out of stock). Vẫn có thể chờ hàng thay thế nên không phải ngừng sản xuất.

sets.title: Business trip to Tokyo
sets.transcript:
W: Hi, Raymond. I just booked your flight to Tokyo for the trade fair. You leave on Monday at 9 A.M.
M: Thanks, Grace. Did you also reserve a hotel?
W: I was about to. There's one near the airport with a good corporate rate.
M: Hmm. The conference center is across the river from the airport.
W: You're right — the traffic could be terrible. I'll look for something within walking distance of the center instead.
M: That would be great. And please make sure the room has a desk; I'll need to prepare my presentation there.

questions.prompt: Why is the man going to Tokyo?
questions.explanation_vi: 'your flight to Tokyo for the trade fair'.

questions.prompt: Why does the man say, "The conference center is across the river from the airport"?

choices.A: To suggest a different hotel location
choices.B: To give directions to the woman
choices.D: To explain why his flight is late

questions.explanation_vi: Anh ấy ngụ ý khách sạn gần sân bay xa trung tâm hội nghị; người phụ nữ hiểu và tìm khách sạn khác.

questions.prompt: What does the man request?
questions.explanation_vi: 'please make sure the room has a desk'.

sets.title: Looking for office space
sets.transcript:
M: Thanks for meeting with me, Ms. Novak. You said you're looking for office space for your accounting firm?
W: That's right. We're growing quickly, and our current office is too small. We need room for about fifteen staff.
M: I have a few properties in mind. What's most important to you?
W: Being close to public transportation. Many of our employees don't drive.
M: Then you'll like the building on Harbor Street. It's right next to the subway station. Could you see it on Thursday afternoon?
W: Thursday works.

questions.prompt: What type of business does the woman work for?
questions.explanation_vi: 'office space for your accounting firm'.

questions.prompt: What is most important to the woman?
questions.explanation_vi: 'Being close to public transportation.'

questions.prompt: When will the woman most likely visit a property?
questions.explanation_vi: 'Could you see it on Thursday afternoon?' — 'Thursday works.'

sets.title: Restaurant menu change (three speakers)
sets.transcript:
M1: Chef, our seafood supplier just called. Because of the storm, they can't deliver any shrimp this week.
W: That's a problem. The shrimp pasta is our most popular dish.
M2: What if we replace the shrimp with grilled chicken for a few days?
W: That could work. Daniel, can you update the specials board and let the servers know before we open?
M2: Sure. I'll also tell them to mention it when customers order.
W: Thanks. And Oscar, please ask the supplier when they expect to deliver again.

questions.prompt: Where most likely do the speakers work?
questions.explanation_vi: Chef, dish, specials board, servers → nhà hàng.

questions.prompt: Why is there a problem?
questions.explanation_vi: Nhà cung cấp không giao được tôm vì bão.

questions.prompt: What is Oscar asked to do?

choices.A: Find out about a delivery date

questions.explanation_vi: 'Oscar, please ask the supplier when they expect to deliver again.' Việc cập nhật bảng là của Daniel.

sets.title: Volunteer program
sets.transcript:
W: Hi, I saw a poster about volunteering at the community center. Are you still looking for people?
M: Yes, we are! We need volunteers for our weekend reading program for children. Do you have any teaching experience?
W: I tutored high school students in math when I was at university.
M: That's helpful. All volunteers attend a two-hour orientation first. The next one is this Saturday at ten.
W: I can make that. Is there anything I need to bring?
M: Just a form of identification. We do a short background check for everyone who works with children.

questions.prompt: How did the woman learn about the program?
questions.explanation_vi: 'I saw a poster about volunteering'.

questions.prompt: What experience does the woman mention?
questions.explanation_vi: 'I tutored high school students in math'.

questions.prompt: What should the woman bring on Saturday?
questions.explanation_vi: 'Just a form of identification.'

sets.title: Car repair
sets.transcript:
W: Hello, this is Mila Rossi. I brought my car in this morning for an oil change. Is it ready?
M: Hi, Ms. Rossi. We finished the oil change, but our mechanic noticed your front brakes are badly worn. I'd recommend replacing them soon.
W: How much would that cost?
M: About three hundred dollars, including labor. We could do it today, but the car wouldn't be ready until tomorrow.
W: I need it for work tomorrow morning. Can I bring it back on Saturday?
M: Of course. I'll book you in for nine o'clock.

questions.prompt: Why did the woman bring her car to the shop?
questions.explanation_vi: 'I brought my car in this morning for an oil change.' Phanh là vấn đề thợ phát hiện thêm.

questions.prompt: What problem does the man mention?

choices.B: Some brakes need to be replaced.
choices.C: The bill is higher than expected.

questions.explanation_vi: 'your front brakes are badly worn' → cần thay.

questions.prompt: What will the woman most likely do on Saturday?
questions.explanation_vi: 'Can I bring it back on Saturday?' — đặt lịch 9 giờ.

sets.title: New training platform
sets.transcript:
M: Have you tried the new online training system yet? We're supposed to finish the data security course by the end of the month.
W: I started it yesterday. The videos are clear, but the quizzes keep freezing on my laptop.
M: Same here. I think it only works properly with the latest version of the browser.
W: Well, I haven't updated mine in a year.
M: That's probably it. The IT department sent instructions on how to update it last week.
W: I'll look for that e-mail now.

questions.prompt: What are the speakers required to do by the end of the month?
questions.explanation_vi: 'finish the data security course by the end of the month'.

questions.prompt: What does the woman imply when she says, "I haven't updated mine in a year"?

choices.B: She does not like the course.
choices.C: Her browser may be causing the problem.

questions.explanation_vi: Hệ thống cần trình duyệt mới nhất; cô ấy chưa cập nhật → có thể đây là nguyên nhân.

questions.prompt: What will the woman do next?
questions.explanation_vi: 'I'll look for that e-mail now.'

sets.title: Building directory (graphic)
sets.image_description: Building directory board in a lobby (see graphic).
sets.transcript:
W: Excuse me, I have a job interview at Brightpath Marketing at eleven. Could you tell me how to get there?
M: Of course. But you should know that Brightpath moved last week. They switched floors with the law firm, so they're on Atlas's old floor now. We haven't updated the directory yet.
W: Thanks for telling me. Should I sign in somewhere?
M: Yes, please write your name in the visitor book and take one of these badges. Please return it when you leave.

questions.prompt: Why is the woman visiting the building?
questions.explanation_vi: 'I have a job interview at Brightpath Marketing'.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. Which floor will the woman go to?
questions.explanation_vi: Brightpath đã đổi tầng với Atlas Legal (tầng 3), nên giờ ở tầng 3; bảng chỉ dẫn chưa được cập nhật.

questions.prompt: What does the man ask the woman to do?
questions.explanation_vi: 'please write your name in the visitor book'.

sets.title: Catering order (graphic)

graphic.title: Green Leaf Catering – Lunch Packages (per person)

sets.transcript:
M: Hi, I'd like to order lunch for a training session next Tuesday. There will be twenty-five people.
W: Certainly. Have you looked at our packages?
M: Yes. We'd like a hot meal, and dessert would be nice too. We'll provide our own drinks, though.
W: Then this package is the right one for you. Do any of your guests have dietary restrictions?
M: A few are vegetarian. I'll e-mail you the exact number tomorrow.

questions.prompt: What event is the man ordering food for?
questions.explanation_vi: 'lunch for a training session next Tuesday'.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. How much will the man pay per person?
questions.explanation_vi: Cần bữa nóng + tráng miệng, tự mang đồ uống → gói Deluxe ($20), không phải Premium.

questions.prompt: What will the man send tomorrow?
questions.explanation_vi: 'A few are vegetarian. I'll e-mail you the exact number tomorrow.'

sets.title: Outdoor festival planning (graphic)
sets.transcript:
W: Have you seen the weather forecast? It doesn't look good for our food festival on Saturday.
M: I just saw it. We can't hold an outdoor event in heavy rain.
W: Should we move it to the next day? The forecast looks great.
M: I think so. The park is available both days. But we'll need to tell the food vendors right away.
W: I'll e-mail them this afternoon. Could you update the event page on our Web site?
M: Sure, I'll do it now.

questions.prompt: What kind of event are the speakers planning?
questions.explanation_vi: 'our food festival on Saturday'.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. On which day will the event most likely be held?
questions.explanation_vi: Dời sang 'the next day' sau thứ Bảy, dự báo nắng → Chủ nhật.

questions.prompt: What will the man do next?
questions.explanation_vi: Người phụ nữ nhờ cập nhật trang sự kiện trên web; anh ấy trả lời 'I'll do it now.' Liên hệ người bán hàng là việc của cô ấy.
